title: Archaeological Museum of Eleusis
geometryBasis: The mapped one-storey perimeter measures about 44 by 11 metres. The photographs establish shallow roofs over parallel gallery rooms, low lower walls, and a taller clean eastern gable.
sectionBasis: Photographs show pale rendered walls, red clay tiled edges, dark rectangular grille windows, a shallow arrival canopy and lower buff masonry terrace. The west and north walls are scaled from the native envelope.
limitations: Standing historic museum exterior and attached approach. The clock tower and archaeological sanctuary have separate identities.
Roof heights, covered gallery detail, north-wall windows and narrow service links are representative.
